scripts.check:python:syntax: uv run python -m compileall packages services modules tests
scripts.test:python:slow: uv run pytest -m slow -n auto --dist loadfile -q
scripts.eval:regression: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_regression_m4_m6
scripts.eval:m8:benchmark: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_benchmark_m8_memory_strategies
scripts.eval:m8:live: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_live_m8_llm
scripts.eval:m9:control-plane: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_regression_m9_control_plane
scripts.eval:m9:acceptance: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_acceptance_m9_capabilities
scripts.eval:g4:multiscene: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_multiscene
scripts.eval:g4:provider-matrix: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_provider_matrix
scripts.eval:g4:provider-matrix:longform: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_provider_matrix_longform
scripts.eval:g4:window-stress: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_window_restart_stress
scripts.eval:g4:real-task-parity: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_real_task_window_parity
scripts.eval:g4:real-task-minimal-workset: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_real_task_minimal_workset
scripts.eval:g4:work-tree-debug: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.evaluation_cli run --suite evalsuite_g4_real_task_work_tree_debug
scripts.release:check: corepack pnpm run check:python:syntax && uv run pytest -q && corepack pnpm run eval:regression && corepack pnpm run eval:m8:benchmark && corepack pnpm run eval:m9:control-plane && corepack pnpm run eval:g2:regression && corepack pnpm run eval:g4:multiscene && corepack pnpm run web:lint && corepack pnpm run web:typecheck && corepack pnpm run web:build
scripts.infra:langfuse:logs: docker compose -f infra/langfuse-compose.yml logs -f langfuse-web langfuse-worker
scripts.ops:backup: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.ops_cli backup create
scripts.ops:restore: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.ops_cli backup restore
scripts.real-user:prepare: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.ops_cli pilot-sandbox create
scripts.real-user:scorecard: uv run python -m yggdrasil_sdk.ops_cli pilot-scorecard summarize
